thread:
Rina (Marketing): Quick: final social playbook for Beta launch. Need 1 long LinkedIn essay, a compact X thread, creator seeding, and inbound routing. Who owns each?
Omar (Growth): I'll take seeding + UTMs. Plan: X thread (tease -> bench stat -> signup push) plus LI essay at 11:00 PT. A/B final CTA on X: Join Beta (60%) vs Book Demo (40%).
Eli (Design): I'll produce hero (1200x900) and 3-slide X carousel (1080x1080). Will create two color variants; flagging accessibility contrast. Need final copy by tomorrow noon.
Rina (Marketing): Messaging anchor: "predictable inference economics" + bench stat: "~60% latency improvement, ~2.8x throughput". No dollar figures. Include founder sentence and one customer anecdote.
Hannah (Ops): Routing: utm_campaign=beta_launch -> queue=beta-sdr; creator links add promo param -> route to creator-queue. BoostBot: new rule suggested for promo capture.
Omar (Growth): Outreach template for creators: "Hey {{name}}, love your work on infra perf. Would you like early Beta access + a quick walkthrough? We can offer an early-access badge." Seed list due EOD Tue.
Rina (Marketing): Pinned reply for X: FAQ + webinar signup -> https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=beta_webinar. Webinar capture should map to webinar-leads queue.
Eli (Design): Uploaded initial assets to /assets/social/beta: hero_v1.png, carousel_v1.zip. Small tweak requested: label bars with % deltas and add alt text.
Omar (Growth): UTM scheme: utm_source={platform}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=beta_launch, utm_content={cta}_{asset}, promo captured separately as promo=CREATOR10 when applicable. Example CSV for scheduler: 
platform,post_time,variant,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,utm_content,asset
x,2029-05-14T16:00:00Z,tease,x,social,beta_launch,tease_v1,carousel-1.png
li,2029-05-14T18:00:00Z,long,linkedin,social,beta_launch,mainhero,hero_v1.png
x,2029-05-14T22:00:00Z,signup,x,social,beta_launch,signup_vA,carousel-3.png
Rina (Marketing): Monitoring: +3h, +12h, +24h. If CTR>2% at +3h, Hannah trigger paid seed boost $1k/day for 3 days. Claire (Paid) to confirm.
Hannah (Ops): I'll implement routing and promo capture. Also adding automation: replies flagged as "high intent" if they include words like "demo", "pricing", "beta" will surface to SDR queue.
Rina (Marketing): Final checklist: assets, LI draft, seed list, UTM tracker, routing rules, monitoring roster. Reconvene Tue 9:30am PT for final signoff. Thanks team :sparkles:
